reviews.review:
There's alot of content for sure! The game is incredibly engaging and has alot of ASSets that make the game more enjoyable. 

The gatcha looter-shooter mechanic of the game of farming for a chance to get an in-game loot box (animorph) and then roll that chance for a chance to get the item you need (ranges from 6% to 32%) is annoying. The developers are CONSTANTLY updating the game and providing feedback real-time to the game.

The First Descendant is a good game, it has really good mechanics for a looter shooter and the gun play seems decent. The characters are all of course beautiful, cool and have interesting backstories. Something other recent games like the dead Concord is lacking. However, it does still need plenty of work but it's just starting. I see a lot of people comparing it to Warframe or Destiny 2. But remember those games had a long time to improve so it seems a little unfair to compare it to those two. (Well Warframe at least) I feel like with enough feedback and push to NEXON The First Descendant could be one of the best Looter Shooters ever. I really hope so as well because I really like TFD I have been switching from my PS5 to PC just to play the game.


Edit: After playing for a while the game does have improvement, but not alot. First, I'll say this, the game is now loaded with content and it also helps the player progress easier than before. It may seem like a bother to players who were used to the previous system but it welcomes newcomers. 

Second: The design of the game looks more flawless now. Characters look cooler, weapons are fantastic (with the right build) and writing (at times) is greats. But some have been toned down and that is not a good thing for players who have built their inventory. 

Third and last: The game does have it's improvements. But it still runs and plays janky. I don't know if it's because of Unreal Engine 5, my graphics card not keeping up, my internet needs checking or i don't have the proper settings on.  But the game runs weird and even awful at times. It is a huge bother and ruins the experience. I didn't have that much issues on PS5, regardless of platform it's embarrassing. Please NEXON, if you are reading this reviews fix these problems. I like TFD and i want it to be successful.

A heavily grindy, bootylicious and fairly well-playing looter shooter.

You run around like a headless chicken, look at butts and shoot things. All whilst farming your heart out for incredibly rare low drop rate items. A LOT of them. All the time. Sounds familiar? Sure is. Been done a million times before in other games. It's an RNG farming simulator, plain and simple. In my brain likened to a clicker or some similar monotone experience.

Did I mention the butts? They're here. Butts.

I like it though. Weirdly. The grind can be quite meditative. It's not a great game - the variation and endgame are quite lacking.

The story is fairly whatever, but it does its part I guess. You'll get lost in the lingo and lose the plot at times. Just as it should be. The art style and environments are pretty nice overall, and some set pieces are damn fine. The character designs are pretty cool for the most part, I have to say. Boobies, scars, butts, masks, butts, tight pecs and power armors galore! And none of it makes sense. Hell yeah. It's very clear whom the lucrative target audience is.

Does it do anything new? No. Absolutely not.

Did it hook me because I was just in the right mood for a complete brainrot of a game at this time in my life? Yes.

Try it. It's free. The microtransactions are cosmetics, boosts and characters. Most of the things you can grind for, apart from some cosmetics, and since the whole point of the game is to grind there really isn't that much incentive to buy most things. Unless you want to pay to not play. Feel free. You get to the endgame quite fast either way.

...well, maybe throw in a few bucks for a battle pass and a waifu hairstyle for Gley. Maybe. -.-
